verdict.rationale: monday.com documents the building blocks for handoffs: agents keep one identity across Slack, WhatsApp, Telegram, Make, MCP and the API, and work can be routed to them by assigning items or @mentioning them in updates, with replies, statuses and follow-ups kept on the item. A hosted MCP server, webhooks/event subscriptions and 2-way sync let external tools and agents reach the same shared board data. These are vendor claims only, and none of them describes explicit agent-to-agent or tool-to-tool context transfer. Missing for 10: documented agent-to-agent handoff with preserved context/history, explicit guarantees that context carries across tool boundaries, independent or hands-on corroboration.
